description: This file contains unit tests for the List class in the ATen library, using Google Test framework. It tests various list operations such as creation, access, modification, iteration, copying, moving, and comparison for different data types including strings, integers, and tensors.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Template class representing a list container in the ATen library.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the element at the specified index.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the element at the specified index.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Removes and returns the element at the specified index.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the list.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Appends an element to the end of the list.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs and appends an element to the end of the list.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the list to the specified size, optionally initializing new elements with a given value.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the list with separate storage.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if two lists share the same storage (identity).
